name: Vel Tech (Avadi)
officialName: Vel Tech Rangarajan Dr. Sagunthala R&D Institute of Science and Technology (Deemed to be University)
summary: Vel Tech was established in 1997 by Col. Prof. Vel. Dr. R. Rangarajan and Dr. Sagunthala Rangarajan and is now a UGC Category-1 deemed-to-be university at Avadi, with UGC 12(B) status. NAAC accredited it A++ (second cycle, CGPA 3.53) for five years from February 2023. B.Tech admission is through its own entrance test, VTUEEE, or on Class XII Maths–Physics–Chemistry marks.

testing.notes: Vel Tech's own engineering entrance exam; scholarships use the better of VTUEEE rank or MPC aggregate.

domesticTuition.notes: Annual tuition for all B.Tech programmes; total annual programme fee ₹3,10,000 with the academic & career advancement and exam fees.

scholarships.name: VTUEEE rank scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: VTUEEE 2026 rank holders (state/UT-wise) with at least 60% in Maths, Physics and Chemistry.
scholarships.coverage: Ranks 1–20: 75% of tuition; ranks 21–500: 50% of tuition
scholarships.applicationProcess: Awarded on VTUEEE rank or MPC aggregate, whichever gives the higher scholarship.

scholarships.name: State/UT MPC topper scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: The admitted candidate with the highest Maths–Physics–Chemistry aggregate from each state or union territory.

deadlines.label: VTUEEE Phase I, Slot 1 — last date to apply (exam 3–6 Jan 2026)
VTUEEE Phase I, Slot 2 — last date to apply (exam 21–24 Feb 2026)
VTUEEE Phase II, Slot 1 — last date to apply (exam 3–6 Apr 2026)
VTUEEE Phase II, Slot 2 — last date to apply (exam 18–21 Apr 2026)

programs.name: B.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering
programs.summary: Four-year B.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering at Vel Tech, Avadi; admission through VTUEEE or MPC marks.

fees.notes: Same annual tuition for all B.Tech programmes.

admission.eligibility: Pass in Class XII (or equivalent) with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry, with at least 60% in MPC.

process.detail: Application fee ₹950.
Phase I (January, February) or Phase II (April) slots.
Seats offered by VTUEEE rank; scholarship by rank or MPC aggregate, whichever is higher.
Annual programme fee ₹3,10,000 plus a one-time refundable ₹5,000 caution deposit.
